summary: Implements a production-ready Node.js backend API with secure integrations to PaymentCore (GraphQL) and Payment Rail (REST), supporting search, drilldowns, refunds, approvals, alerts, and report exports with RBAC and audit logging via Kafka/S3 as defined in the Tech Lead's design.

code_files.description: Handles merchant and payment batch search using PaymentCore GraphQL API via API Gateway with caching and SLA compliance.
Manages refund or adjustment initiation through Payment Actions service and triggers audit logging to Kafka/S3.
Handles payout batch approval applying automated allocation rules and auditing the event.
Exports audit-ready payment reports to S3 and returns download URLs to auditors.
Emit audit events to Kafka topic and also archive payloads to S3 for SOX compliance.
Middleware enforcing RBAC for OpsAnalyst, Manager, and Auditor roles.
